zh: 给定 x 时，各评分互相独立：评分 v 需要 ⌈v/x⌉ 次操作才能不大于 0，总次数就是这些值之和。
x 越大，每个评分所需次数不增，可行性具有单调性；x 取最大评分时只需 n≤M 次，一定可行。所以可以二分答案。
在 [1, 最大评分] 上二分：mid 的总需求 Σ(v+mid−1)/mid（用 64 位累加）不超过 M 则 hi=mid，否则 lo=mid+1；输出 lo。
en: For a given x the ratings are independent: rating v needs ceil(v/x) operations to drop to 0 or below, and the total is the sum of those values.
A larger x never increases any rating's requirement, so feasibility is monotone; x = the largest rating needs only n <= M operations and is always feasible. So binary search the answer.
Binary search on [1, max rating]: if the total demand sum of (v + mid - 1) / mid (accumulated in 64-bit) is at most M, set hi = mid, otherwise lo = mid + 1; print lo.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Binary search x. A rating v needs ceil(v/x) operations; check whether the total demand is at most M.

## Proof of correctness

Each operation reduces a single rating by only x, so a rating needs at least the ceiling number of operations, and repeating the operation achieves it. Ratings are independent, so adding up the demands gives exactly the minimum total. As x grows no demand increases, so feasibility is monotone; x equal to the largest rating needs at most n operations and is guaranteed feasible, so binary search finds the minimum.

## Complexity

Time O(n log(max rating)), space O(n), with the operation total accumulated in 64-bit.
